creatures-movement.keepSummary: creature conservation, exact input/seed continuation, movement/LOD and berry/bag rules, travel/victory ownership and human-limited bot decisions
protections: Nights preserve creature identities and counts; runaways sleep safely and return after loss.
Babies follow/scatter without drowning or unintended load, and feed only from a placed rune.
Grounding preserves takeoff cooldown/input semantics and cannot pull down an already-flying witch.
Full/coarse/frozen simulation follows scheduling and hysteresis without changing the specified pace.
Travel preserves posse membership, routing updates and berry eligibility.
Bot observations and trace data stay detached, with human reaction/input limits and non-renewing danger-aware jobs.

groups.title: Direct movement and creature integrity
groups.reason: Remaining assertions protect count/identity conservation, floor/shore state, eligibility, scheduling and hysteresis. Scripted movement checks are not outcome gates merely because they take steps. Posse membership through a constructed fight is ownership/integrity, not win balance. Second pass adds literal creature-record property order, repeated seed/input digest equality, fixed-step/substep/once-only input integrity, current bag cadence/range, berry stage/adult caps, diagonal speed normalization, configured rise delay/nozzles and ordered victory/conga gates. Those are direct contracts even when numeric or stepped.

groups.title: Human-limited bot observations and decisions
groups.question: Keep controlled bot input and observation contracts?
groups.reason: The39 tests use scripted observations/frames and explicit player clocks, not generated-night strength runs. They enforce detached information, ≥0.25s reaction, ≤8Hz input, bounded non-renewing coverage/quest slots, danger overrides and acknowledgement before another toggle/cycle. The960-frame trace is scripted policy coverage, not a battle outcome.
